summary: The Grünhorn, also called Gross Grünhorn, is a 4,044 m mountain in the Bernese Alps of the Swiss Alps. It stands on a ridge between the Aletsch Glacier to the west and the Fiescher Glacier to the east, which are the two largest glaciers in the Alps. Neighbouring peaks are the Gross Wannenhorn to the south and the Gross Fiescherhorn to the north.
one_line: The Grünhorn is a 4,044 m peak in the Bernese Alps, Switzerland, on a ridge between the Aletsch and Fiescher glaciers.
